businessSummary: Fieldwork Coffee is a fictional neighborhood cafe. Its customers want calm service and a clear menu.

referenceReview.summary: The fictional owner chose original ideas. Use recognizable coffee subjects instead of unrelated geometric icons.

concepts.title: One clear coffee bean
concepts.subject: Coffee bean
concepts.businessConnection: The cafe sells coffee beans. An oval bean with a central seam identifies that product.
concepts.customerReason: A single clear shape supports the calm, simple menu in the brief.
concepts.fontReason: Inter keeps the business name clear on signs and cups.
concepts.colorReason: Dark brown and warm paper follow the saved preference. A restrained rust accent supports the calm character.
concepts.symmetryReason: The oval and central seam use vertical mirror symmetry.

concepts.title: A warm cup of coffee
concepts.subject: Coffee cup and saucer
concepts.businessConnection: The cup represents cafe service. The saucer suggests a calm visit rather than takeaway speed.
concepts.customerReason: The brief describes neighborhood adults who value patient service and a calm cafe.
concepts.fontReason: Fraunces adds warmth to the name. Inter keeps menu and body text clear.
concepts.colorReason: Dark brown, warm paper, and rust follow the owner's saved color preference.
concepts.symmetryReason: The cup uses a front view without a visible handle. Its body and saucer share the vertical center axis.

concepts.title: Coffee to take away
concepts.subject: Takeaway coffee cup
concepts.businessConnection: A lidded cup identifies coffee service and the cup application requested in the brief.
concepts.customerReason: The thick silhouette remains clear on small cup labels and larger signs.
concepts.fontReason: Heavy Inter matches the compact cup and supports distant visibility.
concepts.colorReason: A strong rust accent relates to the saved warm color preference.
concepts.symmetryReason: The lid, tapered body, and central band share vertical mirror symmetry.

concepts.title: Coffee bean seal
concepts.subject: Coffee bean inside a round seal
concepts.businessConnection: The bean identifies the coffee product. The seal provides a compact format for packaging.
concepts.customerReason: A clear product subject helps customers identify a bag of beans at a glance.
concepts.fontReason: The serif name supports a traditional tone. It does not imply a real founding date.
concepts.colorReason: Brown ink and warm paper follow the saved preference and support the traditional type.
concepts.symmetryReason: The circular seal and central bean share the vertical and horizontal axes.

concepts.title: A fine coffee bean
concepts.subject: Outlined coffee bean
concepts.businessConnection: The bean keeps the product recognizable while a light outline creates a quieter treatment.
concepts.customerReason: Open space supports the calm cafe described in the brief.
concepts.fontReason: A lighter Fraunces name complements the thin outline. Check small-size legibility before use.
concepts.colorReason: Dark ink and warm paper preserve calm contrast. The muted accent offers an optional refined tone.
concepts.symmetryReason: The inner and outer ovals share one center. The seam follows the vertical axis.

concepts.title: A friendly coffee cup
concepts.subject: Rounded cup with a steam mark
concepts.businessConnection: The cup and steam suggest a warm drink served at the cafe.
concepts.customerReason: Rounded shapes offer a more friendly alternative while the subject stays clear.
concepts.fontReason: Bold Inter supports the soft, compact silhouette.
concepts.colorReason: A brighter rust accent supports the friendly character while the brown and paper colors follow the saved preference.
concepts.symmetryReason: The handle-free cup and central steam mark use vertical mirror symmetry.

concepts.title: The coffee plant
concepts.subject: Coffee plant with paired leaves
concepts.businessConnection: The plant connects the coffee product to its botanical source. It does not claim a farm or certified origin.
concepts.customerReason: The paired leaves provide a clear plant subject for a product-led identity.
concepts.fontReason: Crisp Inter supports the modular structure and clear menu goal.
concepts.colorReason: Warm brown and paper preserve the saved palette. The measured contrast supports clear labels and menus.
concepts.symmetryReason: Equal leaves sit on opposite sides of a central stem.
